ana: Heads-up: noticed a weird one in the node quickstart. When users set OTEL_AUTO=1 + REDACT_STRICT=1, logs sometimes show `request_id: <missing>` even though the incoming X-Request-Id header is present. Happens in Docker and mac dev.

bryce: Middleware ordering issue? If request-id runs after auto-instrument it can get lost. Any repro?

marta: Minimal snippet from user:
```js
const otel = require('@opentelemetry/auto-instrument')();
app.use(otel);
app.use(require('express-request-id')());
app.use(require('./redact')());
app.use(require('./loghook')());
```
Move request-id above otel and it works.

bryce: Also check log level gating. Our loghook sometimes only attaches under LOG_LEVEL=debug due to initialization paths; with INFO it may not wire into OTEL-wrapped handlers.

marta: Confirmed: span has attribute `http.request_id` but our loghook can't read it because req object is wrapped and headers got scrubbed by redact when REDACT_STRICT=1. Two problems: ordering and redact timing.

security: We can't log raw request ids under strict redact. Proposed controls: add REDACT_ALLOWLIST_HEADERS to allow x-request-id, and HASH_ALLOWLIST_HEADERS option to log HMAC(ids) instead of raw. For prod, use KMS-backed key.

bryce: Short term: patch loghook to resolve id from multiple places: req.requestId, req.headers['x-request-id'], res.getHeader('x-request-id'), and fallback to OTEL span attribute if available. Wrap OTEL access in try/catch. Also honor HASH_ALLOWLIST_HEADERS when set.

ana: (typo)

marta: I'll draft a hotfix PR with a unit test that simulates OTEL replacing req after middleware runs and REDACT_STRICT zeroing headers. Also update quickstart docs: recommend installing request-id middleware before auto-instrumentation or enabling REDACT_ALLOWLIST_HEADERS+HASH_ALLOWLIST_HEADERS.

ci-bot: marta opened PR #5301: "fix(loghook): resilient req-id resolution across OTEL wrappers; redact allowlist + hashing option"  CI queued.

security: Ack pending tests proving only hashed values persist when HASH_ALLOWLIST_HEADERS=1. Add privacy doc blurb once merged.

bryce: Thanks — this should smooth onboarding surprises.
